_comment: High Tide - If there are 2 or more blue cards in your pitch zone, this gets +3{d} and blade break. The prior JSON emitted INTIMIDATE for the blade-break clause (the same hallucination found on 27 Blade Break cards) and gated it on REF_PITCH_IS, which tests a REFERENCED card's pitch value, not a count of blue cards in the pitch zone. UNIMPLEMENTED: the conditional blade-break grant has no DSL primitive (no BLADE_BREAK effect type exists).
